pz_notebook_pages.title: Grandmother's Notebook
pz_notebook_pages.description: Sort through the loose pages and match each pair that belongs together.
hints: Pairs sit next to each other on the table, not across it.
Two pages carry the same leaf pressed inside.
The river sketch matches the page with two wavy lines.

pz_gotong_royong.title: Raising the Shed Together
pz_gotong_royong.description: Put the steps of a village work-day in the right order.
hints: Nothing can be tied before the posts stand.
The thatch goes on after the frame is tied.
The sweep is always last.

pz_net_mend.title: Mending the Net
pz_net_mend.description: Choose the right materials, then lay the mesh on the grid to match the pattern.
hints: Twine is tied with a shuttle, not nailed.
The pattern is symmetrical left to right.
The middle row has fewer holes than the rows above and below.

pz_carving_memory.title: The Carved Wall
pz_carving_memory.description: Match the pairs of carved panels on the wall of the house.
hints: The panels are paired by motif, not by size.
Two of them follow the same curve as the roof edge.
The crossed stick and the rope line are partners.

pz_rendang.title: Cooking Rendang
pz_rendang.description: Pick the right ingredients, put the steps in order, then watch the fire.

steps: Simmer the meat with the spice paste
Cook until the sauce is nearly dry

hints: Six things belong in the pot and two do not.
The spice paste goes in before the coconut milk.
When the marker stays in the golden band the sauce is right.

pz_saluang_song.title: The Saluang Song
pz_saluang_song.description: An old melody for the bamboo flute: keep the beat as the notes pass the golden line.
hints: Press space (or click) exactly as a note reaches the gold line.
The melody starts slowly and speeds up in the middle.
You only need to hit most of the notes, not every one.

pz_ulos_pattern.title: Weaving the Cloth
pz_ulos_pattern.description: Gather the loom materials, then copy the abstract weaving pattern.
hints: Thread is woven; plastic has no place on a loom.
The pattern is mirrored top and bottom.
The middle row is a single line of light.

pz_talempong_pattern.title: The Talempong Set
pz_talempong_pattern.description: Watch which gongs are struck, then strike the same ones.
hints: The lit gongs form a diagonal line.
There are five of them, from top left to bottom right.
You may strike them in any order once you remember them.

pz_danau_search.title: Where Did the Cargo Go?
pz_danau_search.description: Read the clues and mark the spot on the lakeside where the cargo drifted ashore.

clues: The boy saw the basket pass the reed bed on the north side.
It did not reach the rocks - those are in the south.
The cake seller's stall is east of the landing.
It was pulled out just west of the cake stall.

hints: North is towards the top of the picture.
Reeds grow where the water is shallow.
Start from the stall and walk west.

pz_piring_steps.title: The Plate Dance
pz_piring_steps.description: Arrange the dance steps in the order they are performed.
hints: A performance opens with respect and closes with it.
The fast steps come before the final, most difficult part.
The plates are stepped on last, never first.

pz_pasar_match.title: Market Day
pz_pasar_match.description: Match each good with the stall that sells it.
hints: Each good belongs with the trade that makes it.
Thread goes where something is being woven.
Bronze belongs with music.

pz_tumpeng.title: The Celebration Rice
pz_tumpeng.description: Choose the ingredients for a cone of yellow rice, then finish it on the fire.

steps: Steam the rice with turmeric and coconut milk
Arrange the side dishes around it

hints: Turmeric is what makes the rice yellow.
Rice steams before it is shaped; it cannot hold a cone while wet and loose.
Side dishes are arranged after the cone is standing.

pz_batik.title: Drawing with Wax
pz_batik.description: Gather the batik tools, then match the pattern on the cloth.
hints: Wax resists dye, so waxed areas stay light.
This pattern repeats diagonally.
Every corner of the grid is waxed.

pz_gamelan.title: Gamelan Rehearsal
pz_gamelan.description: Follow the drum: strike as each note crosses the line.
hints: Watch the drum, not your hands.
The notes come in groups of four.
Missing one note will not stop the rehearsal.

pz_sawah_water.title: Water for the Terrace
pz_sawah_water.description: Rotate the channels so water runs from the spring to the lowest field.
hints: Two pieces have to join the spring before anything else flows.
Water only moves where two connections meet.
The lowest field is the bottom right corner.

pz_wayang_quiz.title: Stories Behind the Screen
pz_wayang_quiz.description: Answer the questions the puppeteer asks about the stories you have recorded.

questions.q: What is the puppeteer of a wayang kulit performance called?
questions.fact: The dalang voices every character and leads the musicians.

questions.q: Where does the audience of a wayang kulit watch the story?
options: On the same side as the puppets
On the shadow side of the screen
questions.fact: The puppets cast shadows onto a lit screen for the audience.

questions.q: How long can a wayang performance last?
questions.fact: Performances traditionally run through the night.

hints: Think about where the light is.
The screen is lit from behind the puppeteer.
A night performance is the traditional form.

pz_angklung_order.title: Assembling the Angklung
pz_angklung_order.description: Put the steps of playing in a group in the right order.

items: Check that every tube is in its frame
Agree the beat with a nod
Hold the note while others play

hints: Nothing can be played before the instruments are checked.
One shake, one note - the timing has to be agreed first.
Everyone stops together, not one by one.

pz_candi_relief.title: The Stone Gallery
pz_candi_relief.description: Rotate the stone panels until every carved block faces the right way.
hints: Each block only needs turning, never moving.
Click a block once to turn it a quarter turn.
Work row by row from the top.

pz_javanese_market.title: The Morning Market
pz_javanese_market.description: Match each stall with what it sells before the market packs up.
hints: Each object points at the trade it belongs to.
The mallet is padded so the bronze rings soft.
Seedlings come from whoever grows them.

pz_roof_plait.title: Weaving the Roof Panel
pz_roof_plait.description: Choose the right materials and plait the panel to match the pattern.
hints: Rattan is soaked so it bends without cracking.
The pattern has a hollow centre.
The outer ring is completely filled.

pz_karungut.title: A Sung Story
pz_karungut.description: Sing the verses in time: hit the beat as the syllables pass.
hints: Karungut keeps a steady pulse; listen to the drum first.
The phrase groups are short, then a longer pause.
You can miss a syllable and still finish the verse.

pz_river_flow.title: The Blocked Channel
pz_river_flow.description: Turn the channels so the river water reaches the village landing.
hints: The spring is on the left bank, halfway up.
A channel that points away from the next one blocks the whole line.
The landing sits just above the middle of the right edge.

pz_sasirangan.title: Tie-dye Pattern
pz_sasirangan.description: Watch the tied cloth pattern, then tie the same squares.
hints: The ties form a ring around the middle.
Two squares sit in opposite corners.
Count eight ties, not six.

pz_mandau_tools.title: Tools of the Workshop
pz_mandau_tools.description: Match the pairs of tools on the workbench.
hints: Each tool has exactly one twin.
The sharpening stone pairs with nothing metal.
Six pairs, twelve cards.

pz_soto_banjar.title: Soto from the River Market
pz_soto_banjar.description: Choose the soup ingredients and finish the broth at the right moment.

steps: Boil the chicken for the broth
Serve with rice cake and lime

hints: The aromatic spices go in whole and come out before serving.
Broth first, spices second.
Lime goes in the bowl, not the pot.

pz_pasar_logic.title: Which Boat Carries What?
pz_pasar_logic.description: Read the boatmen's statements and work out which boat carries the salt.

clues: Three boats lie at the landing: A, B and C.
Boat A carries fruit, or so its owner says.
Boat C is moored next to the one carrying salt.
Boat B is moored at the far end, away from both others.
data.explain: B and A cannot both be next to the salt, and A is fruit, so C carries it.

hints: The far end has only one neighbour.
A is fruit, so the salt is not in A.
Who is left moored beside A?

pz_gantar_steps.title: Planting Dance
pz_gantar_steps.description: Put the planting steps in order as the dancers do them.

items: Make holes with the dibble stick

hints: Nothing is planted before the ground is cleared.
Seed goes into a hole, never on top of the soil.
The last movement presses the earth down.

pz_tongkonan_carve.title: Carving the Gable
pz_tongkonan_carve.description: Turn the carved panels until the gable pattern matches.
hints: Start with the top row and leave it alone once it is right.
Each click is a quarter turn clockwise.
The centre panel also needs turning.

pz_phinisi_hull.title: Laying the Hull
pz_phinisi_hull.description: Choose the shipbuilding materials and lay out the planks.
hints: No iron goes into a wooden hull.
The pattern narrows towards the keel.
The bottom row is the keel line: two separate points.

pz_kolintang_tune.title: Tuning the Kolintang
pz_kolintang_tune.description: Watch which bars are struck, then strike the same ones.
hints: The lit bars form a small square in the middle.
Four bars, not three.
You may strike them in any order.

pz_coto.title: Coto Makassar
pz_coto.description: Pick the spices for the soup, order the steps, and stop the boil at the right moment.

steps: Grind and add the spice mix

hints: Peanut is what thickens the broth.
Spices go in after the meat is tender.
Stop the boil while the band is gold.

pz_pakarena.title: The Fan Dance
pz_pakarena.description: Move with the drum: hit each beat as it crosses the line.
hints: The drum leads; the dancers follow it, not a count.
The beats come in pairs with a gap between.
Slow is correct here - the dance is deliberately unhurried.

pz_lontara_logic.title: Reading the Palm Leaf
pz_lontara_logic.description: Use the marks on the palm leaf to work out which line belongs to which record.

clues: Four records: genealogy, law, diary, land.
The leaf with the longest line is the genealogy.
The law leaf is the only one with a double mark.
The diary is shorter than the land record.
data.explain: The land record is not the longest, not double-marked and not the shortest.

hints: Compare the lengths before the marks.
The double mark is unique to one record.
Whatever is left is the land record.

pz_bajo_search.title: Where the Fish Are
pz_bajo_search.description: Read the boats' reports and mark the fishing ground on the map.

clues: The water shallows near the stilt walkway on the west side.
Fish were seen where the reef meets the deep channel.
The channel runs south of the village.
The catch was taken just north of the channel, near the reef edge.

hints: West is the left side of the map.
North is up.
The fishing ground sits between the village and the channel.

pz_harbour_match.title: Ports and Cargo
pz_harbour_match.description: Match each cargo with the port it left from.
hints: Each cargo names a place you have already visited or heard about.
Silk comes from where it is woven.
Sago travels by boat, never by road.

pz_honai_build.title: Building the Honai
pz_honai_build.description: Gather the right materials and lay out the roof thatch.
hints: A honai roof is a cone of thatch, thick at the base.
The pattern widens as it goes down.
The bottom three rows are completely filled.

pz_noken_knot.title: Knots of the Noken
pz_noken_knot.description: Match the pairs of knots used to make the bag.
hints: Six knots, twelve cards.
The slip knot is the one that comes undone with a pull.
Work across the top row first.

pz_papeda.title: Papeda and Fish Soup
pz_papeda.description: Choose the right ingredients, stir in order, and stop the boil at the right moment.

steps: Stir in the sago starch slowly
Keep stirring until it turns clear

hints: Sago thickens all at once if the starch goes in too fast.
Stirring is the whole trick.
Stop while the marker is inside the gold band.

pz_tifa_pattern.title: Drum Call
pz_tifa_pattern.description: Watch the drum call, then answer on the same skins.
hints: The call starts at the top corner and closes at the bottom.
Six strikes, not eight.
You may play them in any order to answer.

pz_valley_ditches.title: Watering the Gardens
pz_valley_ditches.description: Turn the ditches so the stream reaches the sweet potato beds.
hints: The stream enters near the top, one across from the corner.
Highland gardens are drained, not flooded, so the ditch must keep running.
The beds are in the bottom row, middle column.

pz_sentani_find.title: Something by the Lake
pz_sentani_find.description: Read the villagers' directions and mark the place on the lakeshore.

clues: The old canoe is on the north shore of the lake.
The painted stones were gathered east of the canoe.
The fish drying racks stand south of the painted stones.
The person you are looking for sits between the drying racks and the water.

hints: North is up, east is right.
Move down from the painted stones to reach the racks.
The lake is towards the bottom of the map.

pz_barkcloth.title: Making Bark Cloth
pz_barkcloth.description: Put the steps of making bark cloth in the right order.
hints: The bark is only beaten after it has been soaked.
Painting comes last of all.
Nothing is dried before it is flat.

pz_bird_logic.title: Watching, Not Catching
pz_bird_logic.description: From the watchers' notes, work out which bird the group is watching.

clues: The bird displays at dawn, not at midday.
It holds the plumes up in a fan above its head.
It is not the one that sings from the same branch all morning.
The watchers never catch or cage anything.
options: The one singing from the branch
The pale bird by the water
data.explain: Only the dawn bird folds its plumes into a fan.

hints: Notes are about behaviour, not about catching.
The display happens at dawn.
Choose the bird the notes describe.

pz_quiz_festival.title: The Keeping of Records
pz_quiz_festival.description: The last test: answer questions from across the whole journey.

questions.q: Which community builds the rumah gadang with its sweeping roof?
questions.fact: The rumah gadang is the Minangkabau house of West Sumatra.
Wax blocks the dye, so waxed areas stay light.

questions.q: What is a noken made from?
questions.fact: Noken is knotted or woven from natural fibre.

questions.q: A pinisi hull is fastened how?
questions.fact: Wooden pegs and caulking hold a pinisi together.

questions.q: Why is rendang cooked until nearly dry?
questions.fact: Slow drying means it keeps for days - useful for travel and celebrations.

options: The trunk of a sago palm
questions.fact: Sago is washed out of the pith of a sago palm trunk.

hints: Every answer is something a person told you on the road.
You can retry the quiz as many times as you like.
Two of these were taught by cooks, two by builders.
